body_html:
@googleguacomole I was originally suggesting the Documenting and Assessing Learning in Informal
and Media-Rich Environments as a possible article for #tjc15 but then you made me think when asking what are we assessing...

and that got me thinking...how was my meaning misconstrued? What does Laura mean...

....then I thought maybe Laura means what she means and that would be fun....

In the article they suggest three level of activity that must be examined for informal or media rich environment

What if as we read we picked some informal space we are involved in (#thoughtvectors, #walkmyworld, #ccourses #edchat, etf) and we applied what we were reading to that space.

http://lchc.ucsd.edu/MacArthur-Learning-Report_2012-12.pdf
